name: Nintendo Museum
statusNote: Read from the official visit-flow page.
howToBuy: Enter the lottery with a Nintendo Account, starting three months before your visit.
Results are emailed on the 1st of the following month, in the afternoon (Japan time).
Pay by the 7th by credit card (3D Secure required), or the tickets are cancelled automatically.
After the lottery, tickets freed by cancellations may be sold first-come, first-served.
rulesToKnow: Your QR code can be issued from 14:00 the day before your visit. Once issued, the ticket cannot be cancelled.

soldOut.label: Kyoto day tours that pass through Uji
Kirby Café: reservations open on the 10th

faq.q: How do I get Nintendo Museum tickets?
faq.a: Through a lottery that opens three months before your visit. Winners are emailed on the 1st of the next month and must pay by the 7th.

sources.quote: Entries will be accepted beginning three months prior to your visit.
